sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule III — Institutional Occupancy Requirements
sources.description: Sets minimum space standards for institutional occupancies including classroom sizes, laboratory dimensions, and circulation requirements.

sources.label: BP 344: Accessibility Law — Dimensional Standards for Institutional Facilities
sources.description: Provides dimensional requirements for accessible routes, ramps, doorways, and sanitary facilities in institutional buildings.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VIII — Stairways and Exit Requirements for Institutional Buildings
sources.description: Specifies stair dimensions, handrail heights, guardrail requirements, and exit widths specific to high-occupancy institutional buildings.

sources.label: DepEd Standard School Building Design Guidelines — Classroom and Circulation Dimensions
sources.description: DepEd guidelines specifying minimum classroom dimensions, corridor widths, and student station clearances used in public school design.
